lines.english: "Now then, let us all pray for the health, safety, and splendid failure of Kitahara Haruki-kun, who will go on his first business trip next week…"
"Hey."
"To think you'd go on a business trip in your first year, you cheeky bastard. Cheers!"
"Cheers!"
Following Takeya's highly inappropriate toast, everyone brought their glasses together.
It's Friday night…
Since I'm going on a business trip next week, I was miraculously allowed to leave early, which is why I can indulge in the company of my friends for the first time in quite a while.
"Hey, Haruki-kun, what do you want to order? I'll go for a cold tofu, fried tofu, a tofu salad and…"
"…How about a cold tofu, fried mochi and a Caesar salad?"
Of course, Setsuna is huddled right next to me as always.
"Ah, I want a mackerel along with a shish kebab mix, and a beef croquette… glug, glug…
Also a beer."
"Don't get ahead of yourself. I'm not participating in your game of chicken, just so you know."
As for Io, she rushed over even though she's still not used to wearing high heels yet. …In fact, she always tries to rush everywhere. She's hardly a good fit for high heels.
"Don't drink too much, Io. If you black out, you might just wake up in bed with me sitting beside you smoking a cigarette."
And of course, my friendship with the completely composed Takeyaーwho somehow has managed to become a proper member of societyーremains intact.
The four of us haven't changed since our university days… no, since our high school days.
"Kitahara-san, I want a bag from Chanel! I'll text you the model later, so don't get it wrong."
"…You can buy those in Japan. You can even buy them online."
"…Why the hell are you here?"
"Oh, I'd like another cup of oolong tea. Also, a tomato slice with seaweed. No dressing with the salad."
"Still bad at listening to people as always…"
…Let me correct myself a little.
There's actually five of us who haven't changed since we were in university… and we've only changed slightly since our high school days.
"What's the problem? This is a day to be celebrated. Actually, just last month… I got a job offer from East Asia TV at the very last second."
"…Seriously? Isn't that a major network?"
"…Yes, she's serious. I know because she's shown me the job offer notice ten times by now."
Ever since that concert, before we knew it, she had already become one of us; this beautiful rose that's full of thorns.
"You've persisted longer than I thought. I was sure you were going to start taking off your clothes any day now."
"I'm amazed a TV station would even accept someone who used to be a gravure model."
"Well, you could call it the fruits of consistent hard work, or simply doing my utmost to pull all the connections I have and taking advantage of their weaknesses."
Yanagihara Tomo. Fourth-year Economics Department student at Houjou University.
Being Miss Houjou two years ago, she still gives off that air even now on campus.
"…I can almost imagine the scene."
"I just hope it doesn't turn into a scandal…"
"Even a scandal can be used as free publicity. Besides, my end goal is to quit my job early on and aim to become an actress or artist."
"She says all this, but she's actually working herself to the bone. She's working on her voice training, English, and of course, her studies."
"…It's hard to believe, but it seems to be the truth."
Just like back then, Yanagihara Tomo is still pestering Setsuna.
However, their strange friendship has continued even after Setsuna graduated… though I'm not even sure it should be considered one.
She's shown up countless times at house parties at the Ogiso household. She knew that Setsuna wanted a job at a records company, and did everything to pull the strings in her favor.
Setsuna sees her singing as a half-hobby, but Yanagihara-san takes it completely seriously and takes Setsuna along for voice training sessions to brush up on her singing.
Even now it seems she's trying to pull her famed "connections" to get "that song" published by a major label. Both Setsuna and Takeya seem a bit tired of her tenacity.
…She's a strange person, and we don't know whether she's a good person or not, even after all this time.
"Anyway, the stuff we spent all day studying in university really is completely useless in the business world."
"I-It is…?"
"University students come into contact with society as they enjoy themselves. By fooling around you'll understand how to socialize with people."
"Well, it certainly is true that Iizuka-senpai has done nothing but act like a fool for seven years."
"…Anyway, by doing that, you'll naturally polish up the skills required of an adult. If you're going to do nothing but research, you might as well stay with the university."
"That's only true for sales work. And besides, it's hard to take what you say seriously when you've only worked for half a year."
"No, it is fundamentally true for any job. As long as you work for a company, being able to properly communicate with people is number one, right?"
"But you know, Haruki seems to be doing quite alright for himself, and studying was practically the only thing he did."
"Well, he's just weird like that. He's a mutant."
"Hey, that's a mean way to put it."
"In the first place, when a dark gloomy nerd, such as this guy, somehow starts being lovey-dovey with the number one idol in our university, can't you see something's gone terribly wrong?"
"That's a low-blow, Takeya… you know he can't refute you when you say something like that."
"…Hey!"
"Setsuna, the number one…? A part of me still would like to refute that statement."
"Stop it everyone, it's embarrassing… It's not like I'm an idol or anything like that."
"And yet she's not embarrassed about the lovey-dovey part…"
"That's called arbitrary information. You should pick a more impartial point of view, if you still claim to be a decent member of society."
"Could it be that you're feeling embarrassed, Haruki-kun?"
"You didn't have to stab me in the back, Setsuna…"
An hour after our toast…
Between our third and fourth round of drinks, everyone's mouths had loosened up.
We're behaving just like in the past: wholehearted, laidback, full of energy, and generally just having a good time.
Is this just an extension of our relationship from university? Or is this just a way to vent the stress we've accumulated…?
"Still though… To think we would actually start complaining about work while sitting at a pub."
"We couldn't have imagined it five years ago, huh?"
"I couldn't even imagine it one year ago."
"To be honest, I still can't comprehend it."
"Is that so? Maybe it's just one of those things…"
"Especially you, Takeya. You've really started rambling a lot recently. Be it about your job, your company or society."
"It's lame…"
"What do you have against lame people? Just last year you said you hated flashy people."
"Huh? A-Aah… ehm… you could say I just… I just hated how you were back then more than anything else, Takeya…"
"Aa-ah, so that's how it is. Whatever am I supposed to do now?"
"Cut it out, Takeya…"
It's been an hour since our toast…
After downing five or six glasses of beer, words that I would usually let slide irritate me to no end.
"You've got it wrong, Haruki… It was my fault just now."
"Io…"
Rather than responding with a joke like she usually would, she instead murmurs her true feelings.
"You know I… I'm actually a bit jealous of everyone."
"What are you…"
"Because… I feel like the only one here who's truly unsatisfied with her job."

"Setsuna managed to become the center of attention at her new company. Haruki has always had high expectations placed on him, and he even manages to live up to them. Even Takeya has been doing unbelievably well since graduating."
All of us spend our days in different places, in different times of the day, and live different lifestyles…
We might never be able to have fun together like we used to.
"Even Tomo has promising prospects ahead of her… It feels like I'm the only one… the only one who…"
"Mizusawa-san…"
Io… successfully realized her ambition of getting a job at a sporting goods maker.
She wanted to work as a designer, but since it's too competitive, she's now busy working in the HR department.
In other words, it was more than a little bit different from the future she had imagined.
"Aa-ah, what's gotten into me? I didn't mean to say all this…"
"If you don't enjoy it, then quit. It's not like there is a person dictating your path to you."
"…What did you say?"
"I keep telling you, Takeya…"
"You don't even try to make any changes yourself, yet you whine about everything handed to you… Who do you think you are?"
There is, however, a person here who hates seeing Io this weak-willed more than anyone.
"I know, how about quitting your job and getting married? I'm sure there is at least one weirdo out there who'd agree to it…"
"…Shut up."
"I-Io…"
"You're the last person I want to be judged by, Takeya… The one single person in the world I can't stand…"
"…It's been a while, want to go at it again?"
"…Bring it on."
"Aa-ah…"
The locale got heated up in a strange way.
Unlike before, these two now switch between fighting in earnest, joking around, insulting each other, and lightheartedly glaring at each other.
It's not due to their familiarity with each other since our university days, nor a means of stress relief.
I'm sure this is something that started earlier than our high school days… before I met either of them…
"H-Haruki-kun…!"
"Kitahara-san… please do something about those two…"
From the tense atmosphere, the two girls sitting next to me hopelessly grab onto my sleeves from both sides.
That's why I need to settle this pointless dispute…
"Excuse me, miss…"
"Yes, what would you like?"
"Can I have a look at the drink menu?"
"Alright, let's go for another drink! This time I'll settle matters for real."
"W-Wait, Takeya-kun… get it together."
"You've really turned into a drunkard, Iizuka-san. All you have to do now is tie a necktie around your head and you'll fit the bill perfectly."
"Where should we go, Setsuna-chan? I'd like somewhere quiet to drink this time."
"You should really go home already. I'll call a taxi and take you home."
"What are you on about? It's finally the weekend. The night is still young…!"
"I'll go outside and call for a taxi. Setsuna, you stay here and watch over them…"
"Alright, how about this? We'll sing karaoke for the after-party. Setsuna-chan, you can sing by yourself as much as you want."
"…I-I can? In that case…"
"…Don't fall for it, Setsuna!"
"C-Could you stop dropping the honorifics for me alone already!?"
"…I'm sorry."
"For what?"
"For showing such a pathetic side of myself…"
"At least you didn't get wrecked like that idiot."
Although, I'm the one who wrecked him…

That miserable expression those two had when they were glaring at each other was beyond something that could be laughed off… In fact, I think their quarrel might have taken a turn toward something different from what it started as.
That's why I tried pouring water… or rather, alcohol on their verbal dispute.
Seeming somewhat relieved at the suggestion I brought forward, they emptied glass after glass that came their way.
This strict referee would never allow the players to get heated up any more. As a result, one hour into the match…
…Both players ended up being supported on the shoulders of the referee, and the first party thus concluded.
"Things have turned out like this between us a lot recently. That's why I'm trying to avoid meeting him alone as much as possible."
"But he wants to meet you, doesn't he? Isn't that one of the causes?"
"…To be honest, I'm confused. After all, he's changed."
"The truth is, you actually understand who he changed for, right?"
Io is right. Takeya has changed.
Back when we were in university, he would brag about his success with women so much that he named his girlfriends after the day of the week he was with them.
That, too, was done with the intention of showing off to us, and especially to Io. That was a part of him that everyone found a bit pathetic.
But now, there isn't even a shadow of a woman around Takeya.
In reality, that's something to be happy about… We all earnestly support Takeya in his hard work in both his public and private life.
"I don't know whose sake it's for, but I do know whose fault it is… It's your fault, Haruki."
"What do you mean, 'my fault'…?"
Except for a single person among his friends.
"Haruki, you ended up fulfilling your feelings toward Setsuna that had lingered for three years… And you fulfilled Setsuna's feelings that had lingered for three years."
"And that's a bad thing…?"
"That's why… I feel like he might have gotten some strange influence from you."
"So you're saying I'm in the wrong?"
"No, you're not in the wrong. I was actually really happy… because I had always been there next to Setsuna, seeing her cry."
"Still… I never would've imagined that Takeya would attempt to apply the same logic to what we have."
Takeya and Io have known each other for ten years.
"Hey… do you know what I did to him before we met you, Haruki?"
"Yeah… we're best friends, after all."
"I see… In that case, you can somewhat understand why I would waver about this, right?"
"You understand what I'm getting at, right? You avoided Setsuna for three years, after all."
When I first met Takeya, these two were already inseparable despite their outwardly rocky relationship.
"Do you… hate Takeya?"
"I wouldn't waste ten years of my life being around someone I hate."
"I see."
In other words, the questionable yet inseparable bond they share is something that's passed the test of time, even more than the history I share with Setsuna.
"Hey, Haruki-kun!"
"What is it?"
"We have a majority vote for karaoke so far. What's your vote?"
"…How about it?"
"You can decide!"
"Roger that! We'll go pick a place now!"
"I don't mind going, but at least let me sing a single song between your sets of five songs, Setsuna."
"Duet! Let's sing a duet! And you can be the chorus too!"
"…I see you restraining yourself is not an option."
"…Hey, Haruki."
"Hm?"
After waving back at Setsuna with a wry smile, Io begins to mutter again.
"What will you do from now on? What are your intentions… about your life with Setsuna?"
"…Is that even a question worth asking at this point?"
And she's talking to me about something that couldn't be any more focal.
"I'm sure that if you two take a step further and make a crucial decision… Takeya will strengthen his resolve even more than now."
"Yeah…"
Io's perception of Takeya is arrogantly rigid.
But that is also the conclusion anyone who watched these two for an hour would reach.
"And then… I'll have to prepare myself too…"
"Hey, Haruki."
And now, Io…
I couldn't shake the feeling that she reached a conclusion that no one else managed to foresee, without hesitation.
"When will you… make your resolve?"
Resolve…
"It's been two years since then, hasn't it? You can now stand on your own, can't you? Setsuna… is waiting, isn't she?"
My resolve… was decided a long time ago.
The only thing left is the timing, nothing else.
"Io, I…"
"Christmas in Europe, huh… How nice to have a romantic vacation. I got invited to Arumi. Don't you think that's a bit uninspired?"
"…Well, that was close. If it wasn't for my business trip, we'd have gone to Arumi as well."
"Give me a break already, you two…"
"There's nothing I can do about it. She's my superior when it comes to things like that."
I see. "Christmas in Europe"…
That is to say, the "timing" I've been waiting for…
…Is already drawing closer.
